basic_details.job_title: NALSAR Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: NALSAR University of Law, Hyderabad is hiring 2 Research Assistants (Law and Economic Regulation) on a contractual basis for the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India's (MoHUA) Regional Centre for Urban Housing and Policy (RCUHP) at the University. The pay is ₹60,000 per month (consolidated), the initial tenure is one year, and the qualification is an Undergraduate Degree in Law or Masters in Law. Applications are accepted online only and close on 28 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only through the online application form given in the notice.
Upload your resumé through the form.
Upload a statement of purpose explaining your interest and the contribution you see yourself making through this position. It must not exceed 500 words.
Submit the CV, documents and any published writing or articles only through this online form.
Submit before the deadline of 28 November 2026.
Incomplete applications in any respect will not be considered.
important_instructions: Call letters for test / interview will be sent only to short-listed candidates. No correspondence will be made with applicants who are not short-listed. The University may consider the names of suitable persons who have not applied but are recommended by experts in their fields. Canvassing in any form on behalf of any candidate will result in automatic disqualification. No interim queries regarding test / interview / selection will be entertained. The University reserves the right not to fill any of the vacancies advertised, if the circumstances so warrant. The University will not be responsible for any technical problems in submission of applications. Any dispute or legal proceeding against the University is restricted to the Courts in Hyderabad. The notice prints these contact details for the University: phone 040-23498104 / 105 / 164 and email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: NALSAR Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Regional Centre for Urban Housing and Policy (RCUHP), associated with MoHUA, Government of India
Research Assistant – Law and Economic Regulation
Initially for one year, extendable based on performance and availability of grants

content_sections.heading: About NALSAR
content_sections.text: NALSAR University of Law, Hyderabad is located at Justice City, Shameerpet, Medchal District, Hyderabad – 500 101. In the notice, it describes itself as an institution that aims to provide quality legal education underlining constitutionalism, rule of law and justice, with a particular focus on social justice for marginalised communities. It also imparts legal education, promotes research and training, writing and publication, and works to promote legal literacy.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice calls the prescribed qualifications and experience "minimum". Meeting them does not entitle a candidate to be called for an interview. The University has the right to relax any of the qualifications and experience.

rows.requirement: Undergraduate Degree in Law or Masters in Law.
Applicants must be fluent in English.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is ₹60,000/- per month (consolidated). The post is on a contractual basis, initially for one year, and may be extended based on performance and availability of grants.

content_sections.heading: NALSAR Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Scope of work: Research and Field Work.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NALSAR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only through the online application form given in the notice. Upload your resumé through the form. Upload a statement of purpose explaining your interest and the contribution you see yourself making through this position. It must not exceed 500 words. Submit the CV, documents and any published writing or articles only through this online form. Submit before the deadline of 28 November 2026. Incomplete applications in any respect will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview. The successful interviewees will then take a written test, and the final selection will be made on that basis. The University may constitute a Screening Committee to scrutinize the applications and short-list candidates. The University reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for online interview on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than the minimum prescribed, or by any other condition it may deem fit. The Selection Committee may decide its own method of evaluating performance in the interview and written test.

The University may consider the names of suitable persons who have not applied but are recommended by experts in their fields. Canvassing in any form on behalf of any candidate will result in automatic disqualification. No interim queries regarding test / interview / selection will be entertained. The University reserves the right not to fill any of the vacancies advertised, if the circumstances so warrant. The University will not be responsible for any technical problems in submission of applications. Any dispute or legal proceeding against the University is restricted to the Courts in Hyderabad. faq.question: Q1. How many Research Assistant posts has NALSAR advertised?
faq.answer: NALSAR has advertised 2 positions for Research Assistant – Law and Economic Regulation, on a contractual basis at the MoHUA Regional Centre for Urban Housing and Policy.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NALSAR Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The application deadline is 28 November 2026. Applications are accepted only through the online form.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NALSAR Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The qualification is an Undergraduate Degree in Law or Masters in Law. The experience required is 0-2 years (post-qualification experience), and applicants must be fluent in English.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NALSAR Research Assistant?
Q5. How do I apply for NALSAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply only through the online application form. Upload your resumé and a statement of purpose of not more than 500 words, along with documents and any published writing or articles.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview. Successful interviewees then take a written test, on which the final selection is made.

faq.question: Q7. Is the NALSAR Research Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is contractual, initially for one year, and may be extended based on performance and availability of grants.

faq.question: Q8. What is the work of the Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The scope of work is given in the notice as Research and Field Work.

faq.question: Q9. Will I get an interview call just because I meet the qualification?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that the prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum, and possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for an interview.
